name: Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen (a red horseshoe on yellow and an atom symbol on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
